title: Neural Representational Geometry of Feature Binding Operations
authors: Laura Sainz Villalba; P. Michael Furlong; Madeleine Bartlett; Nicole Sandra-Yaffa Dumont
one_liner_zh: 该文研究神经表征几何中的特征绑定操作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: The brain faces the feature binding problem: how are multiple stimulus features and variables combined into coherent representations that support flexible behavior? A key finding from neuroscience is that some brain regions employ factorized representations, where distinct features are encoded in neural state space in such a way that enables independent readout and robust generalization. Various algebraic operations have been proposed to model multi-variable representations, but despite extensive study of their theoretical properties (e.g., capacity, noise robustness), it remains unclear which operations produce the representational geometries observed in neural recordings. We systematically evaluate six binding operations implemented in recurrent spiking neural networks performing a working memory task. We find that only superposition and binding with slot-filler structure produce factorized geometry with favorable scaling, while the alternatives do not. These results provide a taxonomy linking algebraic binding operations to neural representational signatures, offering guidance for both computational modelers and experimentalists.
abstract_zh: 大脑面临特征绑定问题：多种刺激特征和变量如何被组合成支持灵活行为的连贯表征？神经科学的一个关键发现是，某些脑区采用因子化表征，其中不同特征在神经状态空间中以支持独立读出和稳健泛化的方式编码。已有多种代数运算被提出用于建模多变量表征，但尽管对其理论性质（如容量、噪声鲁棒性）进行了广泛研究，仍不清楚哪些运算能产生神经记录中观察到的表征几何结构。我们系统评估了六种绑定运算，这些运算在实现工作记忆任务的循环脉冲神经网络中执行。我们发现，只有叠加和具有槽填充结构的绑定能产生具有有利扩展性的因子化几何结构，而其他替代方案则不能。这些结果提供了一个将代数绑定运算与神经表征特征联系起来的分类体系，为计算建模者和实验研究者提供了指导。
